cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: A full inspection. Not the quarterly. Mine. The Book, the chest, the keys, the study, the Ledger. You will find the Ledger is not Company property. You will find I would like to read it anyway.

left.label: The Ledger is mine; the rest is yours
left.outcome: "Noted. Correct." She reads the rest for four hours.

right.label: Read it all
right.outcome: She reads the Ledger. She reads it twice. "Noted." It is the longest 'noted' yet.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: Your entries note the gauge every watch. Dray's did not, until his last year. The Book requires it weekly. For the record, you are more diligent than the Book asks. For the record, that is how it began with him.

left.label: Weekly, then
left.outcome: "Noted." You keep the daily figures in the Ledger instead. She knows.

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: Vosk wired Ardent after the inspection. Coded. I shouldn't have, but I can read the Ardent code now, and it said your name and then 'CURIOUS'. Just that. Is curious bad? It sounds bad.

left.label: It is not good
left.outcome: "Oh. Oh no. Should I. What should I do?" "Nothing." "I'm bad at nothing."

right.label: Send a wire after it: 'DILIGENT'
right.outcome: He sends it, in Vosk's code, in Vosk's name. It is the bravest thing he has done. Ardent is confused for a month.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: Three questions. You will answer or not; both are answers. Have you read the engineer's figures? Have you spoken to the boat-clans about the water? Have you been to the north bank at night?

left.label: Answer honestly
left.outcome: You answer. She writes nothing. "Noted. Thank you. That was not wise."

right.label: Decline all three
right.outcome: "Noted. That was wise. It was also an answer."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You want to know what I am watching for. I will tell you what I told Dray, exactly. I am watching for a Keeper who cares more about the water than the gate. The Company needs the gate. The water needs nobody.

left.label: The water needs someone
left.outcome: "Noted." A pause. "That is what he said. Exactly that."

right.label: Then I care about the gate
right.outcome: "Noted. I have written it. I do not believe it. Neither do you."

cards.speaker: fennick
cards.text: She's asked me for every wire you've ever sent. Copies. I said I don't keep copies. She said 'noted' in the voice. I have copies. Of everything. Do I give them to her or do I burn the office down? Those feel like the options.

left.label: Give her the copies
left.outcome: She reads them all. There is nothing in them. That is what saves you.

right.label: Burn the copies, not the office
right.outcome: He burns them in the stove, shaking. Vosk sees the smoke. "Noted."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The sluice house. You have looked at it. Everyone does. It is a disused valve house on the north bank. For the record, it is on the Board's list of structures not to be entered. For the record, I hold the key.

left.label: Why does a disused valve need a key?
left.outcome: "Because it is on the list. You will find I did not write the list." She has, though. Partly.

right.label: I have no interest in it
right.outcome: "Noted." She looks at you the way she looks at a wrong column.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You were seen on the north bank at the third bell. By me. I was there for the same reason you were. I go every month. I have never once gone in. You will find that is the difference between us, so far.

left.label: Why do you go?
left.outcome: "To make sure it is still closed. To make sure I still want it to be."

right.label: So far
right.outcome: "So far." She does not deny it. She does not write it down.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: The Board has asked whether the sluice house should be 'made permanently secure'. Bricked. For the record, I have delayed answering for eleven years. For the record, I am asking you whether to answer now.

left.label: Brick it
left.outcome: "Noted." Masons come. The door is bricked. Something in her face closes with it.

right.label: Delay another year
right.outcome: "Noted. Another year. It is what I would have said."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: An offer. Irregular. You stop asking about the water. I write 'reliable' in your file every quarter until one of us leaves. Nobody at this summit has ever been offered that. Nobody has needed it.

left.label: Accept
left.outcome: "Noted." She writes 'reliable'. You do not stop asking. She knows. She writes it anyway.

right.label: Refuse
right.outcome: "Noted." She does not write anything. That is worse.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You will find I have been protecting you. Two Board queries about the summit have been answered by me, favorably, without your knowledge. You will find I did not do it for you. I did it because the next Keeper would be worse.

left.label: Thank her anyway
left.outcome: "Do not. Noted." She almost says something else.

right.label: Worse for whom?
right.outcome: "For the water. You care about it. The next one would not. I find I have started to prefer that you do."

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: You have been dealing with the newspaperman. I know. He asked me for a comment on 'the Keeper's water figures'. For the record, I gave none. For the record, I am asking whether the figures were yours or Quenn's.

left.label: Mine
left.outcome: "Noted. That was brave, and untrue. She will be grateful."

right.label: Quenn's
right.outcome: "Noted." Quenn is transferred within the month. You did that.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: My verdict. The Board asked for one; here it is, unsent. 'The Keeper is the first since Dray to see what the summit is. Retain, and God help us.' I do not use that phrase. I used it. You will find I am on your side. Irregularly.

left.label: Send it
left.outcome: She sends it. Ardent is baffled. You have an auditor.

right.label: Burn it; send 'reliable'
right.outcome: "Noted. Wiser. I am tired of wise." She sends 'reliable' and keeps the other.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: My verdict. 'The Keeper is curious beyond the requirements of the post. Recommend removal at the Board's convenience.' I have written it. I have not sent it. You will find I am telling you so that you may leave first, with a reference.

left.label: Take the reference; ask for a month
left.outcome: "A month. Noted." She gives you the month. She does not send the verdict during it.

right.label: Send it; I stay
right.outcome: "Noted." She sends it. The Board does nothing for a long time. Then it does.

cards.speaker: vosk
cards.text: No verdict. For the record, I have told the Board the review is 'ongoing'. It can be ongoing for years. It was for Dray. You will find this is neither protection nor threat. It is the only thing I know how to give.

left.label: Ongoing will do
left.outcome: "Noted." The file stays open. So does the door, a little.
